Experience with or knowledge of the StarRez housing management software platform.
Experience conducting data quality assurance or inventory/bedspace audits in a university or housing environment.
Conduct pre-migration and post-migration audits to verify that student records, bedspaces, renewals, vacates, and summer extensions transfer accurately into StarRez.
Perform routine cross-system reconciliations between StarRez, Oscar Billing, and Operations Grids to ensure identical data, proper bedspace allocation, and timely updates to ready dates.
Monitor new offers and system dashboards to identify errors, resolve anomalies, or escalate technical issues to SR staff and team leads.
Provide recommendations based on audit findings to optimize workflow accuracy and strengthen system reliability.
Proficiency in using computer systems, spreadsheets, and database applications for reporting and data analysis.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a high level of attention to detail when tracing data discrepancies.
Familiarity with campus administrative systems, specifically ARMS and Oscar reporting tools.
Ability to read, write, and follow written and oral instructions in English.
Demonstrated ability to self-manage tasks, track progress against assignment goals, and communicate findings clearly to team members.
